log.msg: STRANGER: A homemade content-editing demo for this site - a markdown file you can open, edit in a form, and save, walked through in five short guides (Thinking, Welcome, Edit, Services, JSON pages). MEANT (page.js comment + description:): 'A CMS out of two seams that already existed: a markdown file is a page, and the dev socket writes files.' The two agree closely - this page already had a plain-language takeaway sentence ('A content management system is three things: content that lives somewhere, a screen to change it, and a way to publish.') before I touched it, unlike the pattern the other 12 reviewers found elsewhere. Verdict: clear, both before and after my fixes.

Primary interaction: first card on the 1280 shot is 'Thinking'. ui-test plan cms-primary-plan.json (5 steps, screenshots 01-05 in scratchpad cms-primary/) - clicked '.page--cms .page-preview:first-child .page-preview-link', location.pathname went / -> /imagine/cms/thinking/, and .page--thinking rendered real content ('Thinking / close / Where the data should live...'). Works as labeled, zero console errors on the click. (.page--cms/.page--thinking read as zero-size rects in steps.json - expected, core/Page uses display:contents for column peers, not a bug.)

Layout at 3440, re-measured (not trusting the critique row, which predates today's realm-alternates task): critique's own row said '31% wide, 2180px dead, depth 6, scroll 1392/1392' and proposed alt 'tile wall, wide column'. That literal alt was NOT applied. realm-alternates (17:43-17:47 today) instead shipped width:large + a genuine third Guide column (the page's own closing paragraph, moved verbatim, classes:default). I independently re-measured via getBoundingClientRect on .page-column-body: at 3440, CMS column right edge lands at x=1584, Guide's at x=2412 of 3440 -> 1028px dead (70.1% used), matching realm-alternates' log exactly. At 1280: Guide's right edge lands at x=1280 -> 0px dead (100% used), also matching. Verdict: alternate applied (a different, better-fitting one than the critique's own suggestion), not reverted, not open - I did not re-widen further. All three invariants hold: nothing at x:0 except the sitewide Imagine hub rail (present on every /imagine/ page, not a per-realm issue); longest paragraph in CMS/Guide measures 648px = 36em at 3440, under the ~40em cap; cms/ has no .css file and its two --column custom properties (edit/page.js, services/page.js) are track-width sizing words, not spacing constants, so no clamp violation.

FIXED 1/3: dead doc link, cms/readme.md line 66 - '[doc/undo-proposal.md](/imagine/cms/doc/undo-proposal.md)' was a raw .md-extension href; Router.js:35 (/DOT-EXT-REGEX/.test) never intercepts those, so clicking it took a reader clean out of the SPA to an unstyled text file (confirmed live before the fix: finalUrl left localhost:8074/imagine/cms/... for a bare-text page, isRaw=true). Added public/imagine/cms/doc/page.js, a route() shim identical in shape to blogx/doc/page.js (already in this repo, already reviewed), and repointed the readme link to /imagine/cms/doc/undo-proposal/. Re-tested live: now renders inside the app with full chrome/breadcrumbs, isRaw=false. Caveat: undeclared in cms's children on purpose (same reasoning blogx's shim states) - it will 404 if the doc/undo-proposal.md file is ever renamed without updating the notes map in doc/page.js; that coupling is the trade-off for not inventing a generic fix in core.

FIXED 2/3: same dead-link bug, cms/edit/readme.md line 17 - '[doc/decisions.md](./doc/decisions.md)'. Added public/imagine/cms/edit/doc/page.js (same shim shape), repointed the link to /imagine/cms/edit/doc/decisions/. Verified live: renders in-app, isRaw=false, zero new console errors. Same caveat as fix 1.

FIXED 3/3: cms/edit/readme.md line 3 also linked '[`page.js`](./page.js)' - a raw source file, not markdown, so no route can sensibly render it (there is no 'view source' page anywhere in the framework to point at). Removed the link, kept the code-styled text: 'page.js is the whole thing.' Caveat: if a source-viewer page is ever added in core, this is a candidate to re-link.

PROPOSED, not fixed (outside my fences): cms/edit/readme.md line 24 also links '[page.store()](/framework/core/Page/doc/method/store.md)' - same .md-extension bug, but the target lives under core/Page/doc/, which has no page.js route shim at all (grep confirmed). The fix belongs to core, not to cms: either core/Page/doc/ grows a route() shim (the same three-line pattern used here and in blogx), or core/Router stops excluding markdown-flavoured deep links and instead lets any page.file()-style page own its own .md children generically. Diff I'd apply if it were mine: add public/framework/core/Page/doc/page.js exporting a Page with route(name){ return KNOWN_DOCS[name] ? {title, content(){return md.file(meta,name+'.md')}} : null }, listing every doc/*.md file core already ships (method/store, columns, roles, panels, css, declaring, ...). One line why upstream: a single shim in core/Page/doc/ fixes this dead-link class for every one of core's own doc pages at once, instead of every realm working around it file-by-file the way cms and blogx just did.

Re-shot 1280 and 3440 after all three fixes. Only network activity in every page checked (front, both fixed doc pages, both readmes) is the pre-existing lazy page.js-then-.md probe (welcome/page.js 404, and readme/page.js 404 on the readme pages themselves) - same class realm-alternates already documented as expected framework behaviour, present before my task started and unchanged by it. Zero new console errors anywhere. Final 1280 shot copied to imagine-review/shots/cms.jpg (105.9KB jpeg, quality 80, under the 150KB cap).

assign.outcome:
**Verdict: clear, both before and after.** `/imagine/cms/` already carried a plain-language takeaway sentence ("A content management system is three things: content that lives somewhere, a screen to change it, and a way to publish") — the pattern the other twelve reviewers found missing elsewhere was not missing here. The primary interaction (click the `Thinking` card) was proven live with `ui-test`: navigates to `/imagine/cms/thinking/` and renders real content, zero console errors. Layout at 3440 was re-measured, not trusted from the critique row: `realm-alternates` (17:43-17:47 today) already applied `width: "large"` plus a genuine third `Guide` column, landing at 1028px dead / 70.1% used at 3440 and 0px dead / 100% used at 1280 — I confirmed both numbers independently via `getBoundingClientRect` and did not re-widen further. All three layout invariants hold (nothing at x:0 but the sitewide hub rail, longest paragraph 36em, no hand-typed spacing constant — cms has no CSS file at all).

**Fixed (3):** two dead `.md`-extension doc links (`cms/readme.md`, `cms/edit/readme.md`) that took a reader clean out of the SPA to raw unstyled text — each got a `doc/page.js` route shim (same shape as blogx's, already in this repo) plus a repointed trailing-slash href, verified live in-app after; one dead `./page.js` source link with no sensible target — delinked, kept as styled text.

**Proposed (1, outside my fences):** `cms/edit/readme.md` also links `/framework/core/Page/doc/method/store.md` — same dead-link bug, but core/Page/doc/ has no route shim at all. Belongs in core: one `doc/page.js` there fixes this link class for every core doc page at once. Diff and reasoning in the task log.
